private_only.hint: Compatibility fallback only. New workflows should use per-workflow scope: private/group, allowlist/denylist and admin-only.

workflow_admin_ids.hint: Comma or newline separated QQ IDs used by per-workflow admin_only scope.

standalone_webui_enabled.hint: Starts the built-in WebUI instead of relying on an AstrBot dashboard page.

standalone_webui_host.hint: Use 0.0.0.0 only when you also configure an access token.

standalone_webui_token.hint: Recommended when the console is exposed beyond localhost.

inject_agent_mode_policy.description: Inject workflow entry policy into conversation
inject_agent_mode_policy.hint: Allows the bot to decide whether natural language should enter a configured workflow.

install_agent_mode_skill.hint: Syncs entry, approval, heartbeat and archive conventions into an AstrBot Skill.

entry_summary_turns.description: Recent turns used for entry summary
entry_summary_turns.hint: Used when a workflow compresses chat context into task_brief.

fallback_summary_provider_id.hint: Uses the current provider when empty.

max_steps_per_tick.hint: Limits one runtime tick to avoid runaway loops.

tool_call_timeout.hint: Maximum wait time for a single tool call.

agent_mode_progress_notice_mode.hint: agent_lab sends throttled progress notices; astrbot follows native tool-call style; silent records state only.

agent_mode_progress_every_tools.hint: Only applies when progress notice mode is agent_lab.

agent_mode_progress_min_interval_seconds.hint: Set 0 to rely only on tool-call count throttling.

truncate_turns.description: Turns dropped when truncating on trigger

workflow_auto_steps_per_tick.description: Workflow auto node steps per tick
workflow_auto_steps_per_tick.hint: Limits deterministic canvas node execution before handing control to ReAct.

task_lease_ttl_seconds.hint: Prevents duplicated heartbeat/manual ticks from running the same task concurrently.

max_seconds_per_tick.hint: Watchdog pauses a task when one tick exceeds this runtime budget.

max_tokens_per_tick.hint: Per-tick token budget recorded from provider usage.

max_total_tool_calls.hint: Total budget for concrete tool/API executions across the task.

max_total_tokens.hint: Total token budget across the task.
